name: Civitai
summary: The central hub for open-source Stable Diffusion, Flux, SDXL, and video LoRA weights plus a browser Buzz-based cloud image & video generator.
ranking_rationale: Indispensable community index for open AI image checkpoints, LoRAs, and prompts—even if on-site generator Buzz rules and payment compliance tighten periodically.

pricing.model: Free model downloads + Buzz credits / Supporter tiers
pricing.free_tier: Model downloads free; small daily free Buzz generation allowance
pricing.notes: Open model downloads stay free; on-site cloud generation uses Buzz tokens or paid Supporter tiers.

pros: Unrivaled library of community SDXL, Flux, Pony, and Illustrious checkpoints and LoRAs
Shows exact prompt metadata, sampler settings, and seed recipes under showcase images
On-site cloud generator tests LoRAs cleanly without local GPU setup
cons: Payment-processor compliance restricts certain explicit tags on cloud Buzz generation
Heavy page scripts and Buzz monetization popups clutter browsing

facts.value: Open-source AI image model repository & cloud generator
Hosts checkpoints, LoRAs, embeddings, workflows, and bounties
Blurred/mature content filters customizable per account tier
